# Burford’s latest research on the list of Law360’s “Hottest Corporate News of the Week”


November 15, 2024


-
-
-
-


Law360 includes Burford’s[latest research](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/insights-research/2024-energy-transition-research/) on the global energy transition.


The article states: “A new survey of 300 general counsel and top in-house lawyers shows they are already dealing with disputes stemming from the global shift toward clean energy, with many respondents anticipating litigation and arbitration costs will rise in coming years.”


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.law360.com/articles/2260155/gcs-brace-for-rising-costs-from-clean-energy-disputes)
